sections.title: Consent - Consequences of Withdrawal
sections.clause_text: The consequences of the withdrawal shall be borne by the Data Principal.
sections.retrieval_text: Section 6 subsection 5 of the DPDP Act. Withdrawal of consent does not retroactively invalidate previous processing.

sections.title: Compensation for Failure to Protect Data
sections.clause_text: A body corporate negligent in reasonable security practices shall pay compensation.
